questions.question: What is the classic mucocutaneous triad that defines dyskeratosis congenita, and what percentage of patients with telomere biology disorders lack this triad at presentation?

Why are tissues with high cellular turnover—such as bone marrow, skin, mucosa, and liver—preferentially affected in telomere biology disorders?
